summary: Add guarded recipe photo attach and clear commands using AnyList upload and save-recipe operations.
reason: Browser capture confirms recipe photos use multipart POST /data/photos/upload followed by the existing save-recipe PBRecipeOperation with the complete recipe and PhotoIds. The CLI now validates image files offline, requires --apply for upload/save, clones the live recipe before changing PhotoIds, verifies attachment or removal by fresh recipe ID read-back, and deliberately reports cache_updated:false because the current recipe cache has no photo-ID column.
validated_outcome: Focused CLI tests prove helper cloning, duplicate prevention, targeted/all clear planning, offline JSON previews, required-file safety, and command registration. MCP tests, JSON validation, gofmt, and git diff --check passed. No live AnyList writes were performed in this slice.
